status: FINAL (post Codex Critic Round; APPROVE_CONDITIONAL reconciled)
objective: Test whether a regime/bear de-risk overlay on the FROZEN valearn orthogonal-alpha module (STR_valearn_70_top25) can lift its collapsed OOS retention (-0.517 active-Sharpe ratio) toward >=0.7 and ease its 45.6% MDD — re-examining the prior factor-rotation conclusion that 'no orthogonal sleeve -> regime overlay OOS-worthless' now that a genuine long-short Carhart4 t=4.11 orthogonal alpha exists as a module.

design.regime_source_primary: unified_regime_signal_daily.parquet Category 5-state (RISK_ON/CAUTION/NEUTRAL/RISK_OFF/CRISIS), frozen classifier, prior month-end label shifted 1 month (t-1 lag)
design.regime_source_crosscheck: regime_jump_daily.parquet SJM JM_State_lag (bull=0/bear=1, already daily t-1 lagged) + additional month shift
design.overlay_mechanism: book-level exposure scalar e(regime) in [0,1] on module monthly net return; (1-e)=cash earning 0 (conservative); 15bps one-way regime-transition turnover. = measurement-graduation §6 beta/regime-timing overlay.
design.rule_derivation: IS-only (first 60% chronological, 2005-03..2017-11). de-risk regime = lowest IS Sharpe (n>=6) = CAUTION (IS Sharpe -0.969). Exposure level e ALSO IS-selectable: CAUTION-off IS Sharpe e0.0=1.093 > e0.5=1.006 -> IS picks e=0.0 without viewing OOS (Codex HIGH#1 resolved).
design.measurement: build_bt_result (monthly, annualization_factor=12, PerformanceAnalytics standard fns) -> audit_bt_result (16 checks, integrity=WARNING from empty-holdings WARNs, 0 FAIL) -> essence_score. No prod/cumprod self-synthesis; net = e*ret - known transition cost; NAV = cumprod(net) value path.
design.pit: regime t-1 lag (LOCF roll then shift); IS-only rule+exposure; module frozen; forward OOS. Codex pit_leak_found=false.

CRISIS_off_e0.0_AX001.note: CRISIS de-risk HURTS — valearn is crisis-rebound, not defensive

sjm_bear_off_e0.0.note: independent regime def confirms bear de-risk hurts

robustness.is_only_exposure_protocol: e=0.0 selected by IS Sharpe alone (1.093>1.006); forward OOS net_SR 0.590 vs baseline 0.466, MDD 34.4% vs 45.6% — NOT OOS-cherry-picked.
robustness.placebo_per_regime: Of all 5 single-regime de-risks, only CAUTION improves OOS_retention vs baseline (-0.372 > RISK_OFF -0.694 > NEUTRAL -1.157 > CRISIS -1.221 > RISK_ON NA). CAUTION worst in BOTH IS and OOS -> economic persistence, not luck.
robustness.leave_one_crash_out: Removing BOTH 2008 and 2020 crash windows, overlay still beats baseline net_SR 0.850 vs 0.810 (MDD identical 30.1%) -> CAUTION benefit NOT a 2-event artifact; persists modestly in non-crash periods.
robustness.risk_on_throttle: RISK_ON e0.5 -> OOS_retention -1.423 (much worse): RISK_ON is BOTH the OOS-alpha-decay regime AND the bulk-carry regime; exposure scaling cannot time it. RISK_ON would be an IS-violating choice (IS Sharpe 1.08).

mechanism: valearn is a counter-cyclical value module: best in CRISIS (full +7.4%/mo, OOS active +2.26%/mo Sharpe 0.59), worst in CAUTION (-3.1%/mo). The -45.6% MDD bottoms occur 2020-03 / 2008-10 whose t-1 regime label is CAUTION (classifier flags CRISIS only the month AFTER the crash), so CRISIS de-risk fires post-crash and strips the rebound. The OOS active-alpha collapse is concentrated in the dominant RISK_ON state (n=81=79% of OOS, active -0.40%/mo) = earnings-rev OOS decay + market-beta drag — un-timeable by book-level exposure.

verdict_detail.alpha_retention: FAIL — overlay cannot lift OOS_retention positive (best IS-clean variant -0.372, far below 0.5/0.7 gates). SR2.5 not demonstrated. The long-only translation break is cross-sectional selection failure in the dominant RISK_ON regime, NOT a timing problem.
verdict_detail.risk_repair: PARTIAL PASS — CAUTION-off (e0.0, IS-selected) eases MDD 45.6%->34.4% (-11.2pp), lifts net_SR 0.713->0.881, Calmar 0.323->0.516, grade F->C. leave-crash-out robust.
verdict_detail.project_factor_rotation_update: Prior conclusion 'no orthogonal sleeve -> overlay worthless' is REFINED, not overturned: even WITH a genuine orthogonal alpha (valearn), regime overlay only trims the tail (MDD); it does NOT restore OOS alpha-retention. Orthogonal-sleeve existence is NOT a sufficient condition for overlay to make a sleeve OOS-robust. STR_1715's overlay success (OOS 0.91) came from a multi-factor consensus base whose alpha persists in normal regimes; valearn's single value+earnings-rev base decays in the dominant normal (RISK_ON) regime, which exposure timing cannot fix.
